limitations: League rating.json contains ONLY aggregate route metrics, NOT per-scenario breakdown. Per-scenario route data had to be reconstructed from match_results.json candidate_policy_stats.move_route_aggregate.
V3D only covers 3 out of 43 unique scenarios (1231, 1531, 1910631192), insufficient for general route reliability claims.
V3F archived_route_reproduction.json explicitly states it uses the same league aggregate data (no per-scenario V3F reproduction data).
The league uses max_steps=400 while V3D uses timeout_steps=2000, so game length differs between datasets.
League has tactical_model_loaded_count=0 (no tactical model), while V3D has tactical_model_loaded=true.
Grep output (route_full_coverage_grep.txt, ~500k lines) is mostly noise from other report files; only scenario IDs and route aggregate numbers are useful.
Opponent (IncumbentAI baseline) route data exists in match_results.json but was not extracted for this inventory; only candidate (challenger) data was analyzed.
SDK scenario files exist for all 43 unique scenarios plus 7 extras not used in this league.
5 scenarios have additional SDK scenario files not in the league (1631, 2201010101, 2201010105, 2201010109, 2201010110, 3231, 3631).
